ratified: /review 708 (off-enum rulings 1-4, Architect-ratified in-tic via AskUserQuestion question set)

enum.tentative: single-source lesson; no independent conformation yet (the birth default)
enum.reinforced: multiple independent sources or a validated recurrence of the same pattern
enum.convergent: independent lanes converged on the same centroid from different evidence
enum.measured: instrument-measured in-lane at extraction (set-difference, count, or probe computed in the producing cycle) — not inferred
enum.measured_single_locus: measured, with an explicit single-locus scope fence: the measurement generalizes as method, not as population claim

absence: field absent (or null) = no tier asserted. This is the lawful representation of 'no tier'; ruling 2 refuses absence-markers-as-values.

refused_as_tier.confidence_class_reason: lawful members of the confidence_class enum (federation KI artifact-language-must-not-exceed-its-declared-confidence-classification) — a value in this list appearing in confidence_tier is field-routing bleed (ruling 1), not a tier
refused_as_tier.non_tier_reason: absence/observation markers, not tiers (ruling 2): admission would launder absence as epistemics; represent 'no tier asserted' by omitting the field

historical_disclosure: 45 pre-708 rows (latest-per-id, births 122-706) carry off-enum values: exact(6) -> row-scoped field-routing repair (ruling 1); unknown(9)+observed(22) -> stay disclosed, typed absence prospectively (ruling 2); measured(1)+measured_single_locus(2) -> ADMITTED (ruling 3); high(3)+resolved(1)+validated(1) -> per-row classification via the correction lane (ruling 3 rider). Unchanged carry-forward of a historical off-enum value through copy-forward is permitted and disclosed; INTRODUCTION of an off-enum value is refused (ruling 4).
